criteria.criterion: `vloop intervention set <id> recommended|decided|adjusted <value>` accepts recommended 1 to the option count, decided 1 to the option count, `other` or `""`, and adjusted `true` or `false`; a value outside the record's option count (including any decided on a record without options) is refused, the file untouched.
criteria.evidence: intervention.go Set validates recommended/decided/adjusted against len(v.Options) before writing; n==0 refused; TestInterventionSetChoice checks 3 refused and file unchanged. decided "" is refused on records with options (T1 derivation rejects an empty decision), a reasonable reading.

criteria.criterion: Every accepted set rewrites agreement in the same write, by T1's derivation; the body of the record is not changed; `adjusted: true` appears only while the decided option is adjusted.
criteria.evidence: Set calls DeriveAgreement and updates agreement in one WriteFile; only frontmatter lines are touched; adjusted line removed when false or decided=other; test asserts it does not linger.

criteria.criterion: `set … agreement …` exits 2 with exactly `vloop: agreement is derived — set decided, adjusted or recommended instead`; `set … options …` exits 2 with exactly `vloop: options are recorded with the intervention, not set`; neither touches the file. Violation to rule against: any path that writes agreement from a value the caller supplied.
criteria.evidence: Set returns the exact messages before any file access; test asserts code 2, exact stderr and unchanged file. agreement is written only from DeriveAgreement.

criteria.criterion: The v1 fields (brief, phase, kind, automatable, by, occurred) stay settable as before.
criteria.evidence: SetFields keeps them; brief quoting path preserved; generic update path preserves old replace-or-insert behaviour.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests cover each new field, the re-derived agreement after each set, and both refusals.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/intervention_test.go TestInterventionSetChoice covers decided, adjusted, recommended, agreement results and both refusals.

notes: Criterion 1's "" value is ambiguous in the brief; the implementation refuses empty decided on records with options.
